The scent opened fresh and settled into a soft wearable fragrance that lasted for hours. I would recommend it for someone who wants a practical perfume that feels dependable for regular use.

title: Worth repurchasing
text: I bought NYX Professional Makeup Dermatologist Tested Daily Resurfacing Liquid after comparing a few beauty products, and it gave me visible improvement. It smoothed rough texture and helped my complexion look clearer without being too harsh. I would recommend it for someone who wants a practical exfoliator that feels dependable for regular use.
